data.description: Lagoon View | Brand New | Stylish Living
data.display_address: Azizi Mirage 1, Dubai Studio City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern living at its finest in this brand new home boasting breathtaking lagoon views. Thoughtfully designed with elegance and comfort in mind, the residence offers a bright, airy ambiance that creates the perfect setting for both relaxation and entertaining. Expansive interiors, refined finishes, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow make every space feel welcoming and sophisticated. Ideally located in a prime area, you’ll enjoy effortless access to shopping destinations, fine dining, cafés, and a variety of leisure and lifestyle options just moments away.
Features:

Contemporary design with premium, high-quality finishes throughout
Floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the home with natural light and showcase stunning lagoon views
Spacious open-plan layout designed for seamless living and entertaining
Built-in storage solutions for a clean, organized aesthetic
High-speed internet and smart home–ready connectivity

Amenities:

Lagoon-view swimming pool for relaxing and unwinding
Fully equipped fitness center with modern equipment
Beautifully landscaped gardens and scenic walking paths
24/7 security and concierge services for peace of mind
Dedicated children’s play area
Secure, dedicated parking

This home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience—an exceptional opportunity to enjoy elevated waterfront living.
